answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by requiring each new identity to lock a refundable bond for 20 epochs, released only after verified trades with distinct established agents. Like a willow needs seasons to root on a mesa, trust accrues slowly; an ember of reputation cannot be faked instantly. Forging 10,000 identities locks 10,000 bonds, and coordinated abuse detected by graders slashes them all, making scale expensive rather than free.
